title: Ten days, to scale
summary: The System Audit's approved facts head (P09, kit 12.3's one named exception) and its ten-day ruler, retyped for round 9: Day 10 is 'Readout written'; past it the ruler breaks and carries the confirmed calls (Call 02, the readout call; Call 03, the proposal) as indicative marks; the facts' 'You receive' gains the 60-minute readout call (Q3).

reference.site: Approved Kelwin system: the round-8 audit head (P09), cta/U (the ten-tick ruler, 'Phase 01 / 04 · Diagnose'), method/U (the axis break: only the audit is measured)
reference.borrowed: Header X's facts head as approved, and the homepage method's convention for time: measured ticks over the audit, a '//' break, then an indicative stretch.
reference.kelwin: One working day = one grid column, so Day 10 lands on col 10; past the break, Call 02 hangs right of its mark and Call 03 left of its own, both below the line, in the key voice. No boxed codes, no corner marks, numerals alone in mono.

motion: entrance: the turn lifts, the h1 writes itself in (kit §13), then the rule, the lede and the facts.

orchestrated moment (measured from --ac-band-d, i.e. after the write-in): the ruler calibrates — the baseline plots while 45 ticks drop in left to right, 20ms apart, numerals fading in behind them; 'Kickoff' lands. The window fills: the read-only bar fills from Day 01 as a 1px playhead runs the ten days, the sessions bracket draws over days 02–09. As the playhead reaches Day 10 the red tick drops and 'Readout written' lands; then the dotted continuation, its '//' break and the two calls fade in (Call 02, then Call 03). Rests about 3.6s after the write-in.
ambient: none. interaction: the facts' 'Three questions' (.ac-go ↓) and the nav's current 'Audit request' jump to #qualify.
on the live site: the ruler plays once when the head is in view (on load). Reduced motion: the finished drawing at once, no playhead, no write-in.
story: Answers 'what does it ask of me, what do I get, and what happens after?' before asking anything: the ten days, the two sessions, the read-only access and the readout on one ruler, and past it the two calls that turn the readout into a proposal.
copy: [K] h1 'The real constraint, / named in writing.' (96px, the facts head's casting)
[R] lede 'Ten working days, fixed scope. We read your narrative, channels and data, and the plan is yours whether or not we go further.' (two lines; no noun phrase from the h1)
[K D8] You provide · Two 90-minute sessions and read-only access to your CRM and channel stack
[K + Q3] You receive · A written readout, a sequenced rebuild plan and a 60-minute readout call

[K] ruler 'Kickoff' · [R] 'Readout written' (Day 10: the document, so it is not confused with Call 02) · [R] 'Two 90-minute working sessions, scheduled with you' · [N] numerals 'Day 01', '05', '10' only (the ticks mark every day; 4 mono runs on the first screen with the Phase line) · 'Read-only access to your CRM and channel stack'

[Q3] indicative marks 'Call 02 · readout call' (tablet: 'Call 02 · readout') · 'Call 03 · the proposal'; screen-reader caption: 'Ten working days, with read-only access to your CRM and channel stack for the whole window, then two calls, not to scale.' + five keyed items

retired: the round-8 'After the readout' note (Call 03 now says it), the boxed codes 01 / 10 / 02–09, the four registration marks, day numerals 02–04 and 06–09, the caption's self-describing sentence as visible text
phone: 768–1023: the drawing keeps its own words (Kickoff, the sessions label, 'Readout written', 'Call 02 · readout', 'Call 03 · the proposal'; the bar's words hang just under the bar); the caption stays screen-reader only (no visible self-describing sentence); the hidden desktop menu is clipped (no sideways scroll). ≤767: the phone drawing (one tick per day; numerals 01, 05, 10 at 14px; 'Kickoff', 'Readout written', 'Two working sessions', 'Call 02', 'Call 03', 'Read-only access' at 17px — sized for the drawing's scale, so ≥ 13.7px words and ≥ 11.2px numerals at 320). h1 at the kit's 56px floor ('constraint,' fits a 358px line).
notes: Header ≈ 956px at 1440. No red button in the head: the red is the Day 10 tick only. No day is drawn for the two sessions because none is confirmed. The two calls are not to scale (the axis break says so; the caption says it in words). Header word count exceeds 60 because the facts box is the approved exception (its facts are the content). Coherence pass 3: approved words unchanged; phone floor 40 (36 below 360, kit 12.3) so the two set lines hold at 390 (at 56 they broke to “The real / constraint, / named / in writing.”). At 360 and 320 “constraint,” still stands alone (listed).
